$comment: Tunable QA rules. coverage.* is read by scripts/auto-qa-tuner.mjs (.github/workflows/auto-qa.yml); nightly.* and licence.* are read by .github/workflows/nightly-compliance.yml. Tuning never lowers a floor automatically and never commits: raises are proposed in a tracking issue and applied by a human.

coverage.note: Headroom is measured minus floor, per area and metric, in percentage points. When it exceeds raise_floor_when_headroom_exceeds the proposed floor is floor(measured - buffer_below_measured); it is never above that and never below the current floor.

nightly.note: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=<audit_level> is report-only while audit_blocking is false: main carries known high and critical advisories in production dependencies (proxy-addr and others) that need dependency upgrades, and a nightly that is always red gets ignored. Set audit_blocking to true once npm audit is clean.

licence.note: AGENTS.md section Licensing: LICENSE.MIT is kept verbatim (hash recorded here), package.json and backend/config/swagger.js say GPL-3.0-only. Changing the recorded hash is a deliberate owner decision.
